chunks: Those before them had also denied, and they could not reach a tenth of (the possibilities) We had given them, and still they called My apostles liars. How great was the change that I wrought in their condition then!

key_terms.مِعْشَارَ: a tenth part or tenth portion

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'a tenth' of blessings in Surah Saba?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the paradox of divine generosity versus human ingratitude, noting that previous nations squandered even a tenth of the blessings bestowed upon them. It underscores the inevitability of divine retribution (nakir) for those who reject the Prophets, serving as a warning to the contemporary audience of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) to avoid the same fate of spiritual blindness despite abundant guidance.
